# Areex Cloud

> Areex Cloud is an Indian hosting company offering Minecraft server hosting, Discord bot hosting (Python and Node.js), KVM VPS and domains. Servers are created automatically after payment.

Website: https://areexcloud.site
Game panel: https://panel.areexcloud.site
Founder: Piyush Garai. Piyush Garai is the founder of Areex Cloud.
Community: https://discord.gg/pV25HWmZwZ

## Key facts
- Server locations: Mumbai, Noida and Singapore (chosen at checkout).
- Payments: Razorpay in INR (UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, RuPay / Visa / Mastercard cards, net banking).
- Crypto, BDT, PKR and other currencies: open a support ticket (website chat or Discord) to order manually.
- Refunds: 24-hour refund window after deployment; domain registrations and dedicated IPv4 are non-refundable.
- Every customer gets a game panel with a live console, file manager, backups, mod and plugin installers.
- The same email and password work on the website and on the panel.
- Support: 24/7 chat on the website and a Discord community.
